# Mise en Price

> Recipe costing and menu pricing software for UK chefs, caterers and independent restaurants.

Mise en Price is a web-based tool for calculating ingredient cost per portion and food-cost gross profit. It also provides a supplier price book, invoice scanning with manual review, saved recipes, and CSV export. Ingredient-based GP excludes labour, overheads and waste. Invoice results should be checked before import.

The public recipe calculator can be tried without creating an account. The full app offers a 14-day free trial with no card required. After the trial, users may choose a £9.99/month subscription. The card-free trial does not charge automatically when it ends.

## Main pages

- [Mise en Price homepage](https://miseenprice.co.uk/): Product overview, free one-recipe calculator, features and pricing.
- [Recipe costing software](https://miseenprice.co.uk/recipe-costing-software): Recipe and portion costs for chefs.
- [Free recipe costing calculator](https://miseenprice.co.uk/free-recipe-costing-calculator): Calculate food costs using ingredient quantities and prices.
- [Food GP calculator](https://miseenprice.co.uk/food-gp-calculator): Explains food gross profit calculations.
- [Invoice scanning for chefs](https://miseenprice.co.uk/invoice-scanning-for-chefs): Supplier invoice import and manual review.
- [Supplier price tracking](https://miseenprice.co.uk/restaurant-supplier-price-tracking): Price-book information for kitchens.
- [Catering recipe costing](https://miseenprice.co.uk/catering-recipe-costing): Costing for caterers.
- [Menu pricing guide](https://miseenprice.co.uk/restaurant-menu-pricing-guide): Menu pricing guidance.
